title: Islam: A Concept of Political World Invasion
author: R. V. Bhasin
current_text: The Maharashtra government banned R. V. Bhasin’s Islam: A Concept of Political World Invasion in 2007, saying it contained derogatory remarks about Islam that could hurt religious sentiments; Bhasin challenged the ban, which the Bombay High Court upheld.

sources.quote: The Maharashtra government had banned the book in 2007 onthe grounds that it contained derogatory remarks about Islam that could hurtreligious sentiments. Advocate R V Bhasin, writer of the book, hadchallenged the ban.
sources.title: Bombay HC upholds ban on Islamic book | Mumbai News - The Times of India

sources.quote: MUMBAI: The Bombay High Court today upheld the ban on the book 'Islam - A Concept of Political World Invasion by Muslims'. The Maharashtra government had banned the book in 2007 onthe grounds that it contained derogatory remarks about Islam that could hurtreligious sentiments.
sources.title: Bombay HC upholds ban on Islamic book | Mumbai News - The Times of India

sources.quote: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday upheld the Maharashtra state government’s ban on a book by a Supreme Court advocate, R.V. Bhasin, titled, ‘Islam – A concept of Political World Invasion’.
sources.title: The Bombay HC has Ban the book but keep the ebook - Bar & Bench

ban_rows.note: State: Maharashtra. The book was released in 2003. It was banned by the Congress government in 2007 ground that it contained derogatory remarks about Islam and Prophet Mohammad. In 2010, Bombay High Court upheld the ban. The decision was challenged in the Supreme Court but it rejected the appeal.
